title: Two module pullback comparisons differ by an ordinary target automorphism
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], schemes X,Y, a morphism a:X -> Y whose tensor pullback is additive, and an arbitrary O_Y-module G. Let c0,c:La*(G[0]) -> (a*G)[0] both satisfy [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map] IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison. Then there exists an O_X-module isomorphism alpha:a*G -> a*G such that c = c0 followed by alpha[0]. No flatness, quasi-coherence, direct image, cover or base-change square is required.

source.place: Steps 2--5, independence of comparison; Step 4 of lem-pc-affine-alternating-cech-base-change-factorization; Stacks Tag 06YJ (derived pullback via K-flat complexes), and standard truncation argument written by Q1

proof.text: Compare the witnessing derived counits by right Kan extension uniqueness. Construct the standard comparison using a flat resolution of G concentrated in nonpositive degrees. Its tensor pullback is nonpositive and right exactness identifies H0 with a*G. The other counit differs by an invertible natural automorphism of La*, so both c0 and c induce isomorphisms on H0.

In the truncation triangle tau_le_minus_one E -> E -> H0(E)[0], for E=La*(G[0]), orthogonality kills maps from both the negative truncation and its shift by one to (a*G)[0]. Therefore every map from E to this single module factors uniquely through H0(E)[0]. Take alpha to be H0(c) after the inverse of H0(c0), transported through the canonical single-functor H0 isomorphism. It is invertible. Full faithfulness of the single functor and uniqueness of the factorization give c=c0 followed by alpha[0]. The zero module and empty schemes are included.

theorem modulePullbackComparison_target_automorphism
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Y) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    (G : Y.Modules)
    (c₀ c : (derivedPullback a).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G))
    (hc₀ : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c₀)
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c) :
    ∃ α : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G,
      c = c₀ ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map α.hom
